scope: Owner-operated startup objectives for one workspace. No historical usage data or third-party telemetry is required.

prerequisites: Stop API and worker writes, then set PRIVATE_PRODUCTION_WRITES_QUIESCED=true only for the backup invocation.
Use the pinned PostgreSQL 18.4 pg_dump and pg_restore clients and a reachable S3-compatible endpoint.
Restore only into an empty isolated database and bucket, then set PRIVATE_PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_TARGET=true only for the restore invocation.
Keep database, object-storage, archive-encryption, and key material outside the archive and provide them through the OPS-001D secret boundary.
recovery.promotionRule: Promote only an exit-zero restored result with zero missing and extra objects and met RPO/RTO; otherwise discard the isolated target and retry from the last valid archive.
